bio.text: Patrick Martinez is a Democratic Party district leader (since 2022) and a five-year member of Queens Community Board 2, according to City & State, which reported in February 2026 that he was running for the 30th Assembly District seat held by Steven Raga.
City & State reported that he works in digital ad sales, lives in Woodside and is the nephew of former Rep. Joe Crowley.
The Queens Daily Eagle reported in July 2026 that he won the Democratic primary for the seat by seven votes after a recount.

sources.title: Patrick Martinez, nephew of Joe Crowley, launches Assembly bid
Patrick Martinez wins Assembly District 30 primary by seven votes
